events.label: Chase Lackard November 2024 weapons arrest and police shooting

slots.name: hospital condition
slots.sentence: He was then taken to a nearby hospital in stable condition and later pleaded not guilty to the charges, the official said.

slots.name: criminal charge count
slots.sentence: Mr. Lackard has been criminally charged at least twice in New York City, with offenses related to weapons possession, according to court documents.

slots.name: arrest date
slots.sentence: Later that year, in November, Mr. Lackard was arrested in the Bronx on a slate of charges, including criminal possession of a weapon and menacing, after pulling out a loaded gun and pointing it at several uniformed police officers, the law enforcement official said.

slots.name: age at arrest
slots.sentence: The officers responded by firing at Mr. Lackard, who was 19 at the time, striking him.
